newsitem.title: POLAND: Nomura sees Polish banks as buying opportunity.
newsitem.headline: Nomura sees Polish banks as buying opportunity.

text.p: Polish listed banks' underperformance late in 1996 and early this year offers creates a buying opportunity, Nomura Equity Research in London said in its April report.
Nomura said in its East European Monthly the average 1997 price earnings ratio of seven banks in its peer group was of 6.7, which compared with 10.8 for all Central European banks.
"Stock valuations of the Polish banks are in most cases attractive following recent declines," it said, adding that the medium-to-long term prospects for the Polish banking industry were positive.

Nomura also said banks' profits could rise in March-December by some 20 percent, which would make up for a decline in earnings in the first two months of the year and result in a 15 percent real growth for the whole of 1997.
